state.paragraph: On September 23, 2013, representatives from Goodwin Procter participated in a telephone conference call with Mr. Rothenberg and his counsel to inform Mr. Rothenberg, on a limited basis, of the status of the Special Committee's review of strategic alternatives and the negotiations between Mac-Gray and CSC and Pamplona to provide Moab with the opportunity to resume discussions with CSC/Pamplona regarding a possible equity rollover of Moab's shares in the transaction if Moab still had an interest in such a rollover. Mr. Rothenberg indicated he would like to discuss the possibility of an equity rollover with CSC/Pamplona and it was agreed that representatives of BofA Merrill Lynch would arrange and facilitate such a discussion.

ledger_rows.Note: Preferred bidder and price requirement: CSC/Pamplona is best on value, certainty and risk (Party B's options and financing riskier). Exclusivity offered at $21.25; MacDonald supports $21.25.

Raised from $20.75 (#35) the same day the committee asked. Conditioned on 2-week exclusivity; asks for voting agreements from MacDonald. Pamplona funds 100%, no financing contingency; confirmatory diligence only (Light).
Executed, authorized 09/23; exclusive until 5 p.m. 10/12/2013. Ends if CSC/Pamplona adversely changes the $21.25 final proposal. CSC/Pamplona then got full data-room access.
Inferred: displaced when exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona was executed; not reported told. On 09/18 it declined to improve its $18.00-$19.00 range (#36).

Inferred date: displaced by exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona. Reason from the committee on 09/19: Party B's options were contingent and deferred, and its financing riskier, despite the higher face value.
Outside legal counsel to CSC/Pamplona; first seen acting when it received the target's first merger agreement draft.
Rollover resolved: talks with Pamplona, allowed from 09/23, end with no Moab rollover (reported 10/07). Moab signed a voting agreement at signing.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
